title: What guests say
intro: Recent reviews from Booking.com, all scored 10 out of 10.

items.name: Leanne
items.text: Location was great. Room was very roomy and comfortable. Host was great, couldn't do enough for you.

items.name: Katarzyna
items.text: Great value for money. The property is in a good location, it's comfortable and clean. Kitchen facilities are great.

items.name: Megan
items.text: Was a great place to stay. The beds were comfy, rooms were spacious with a great ensuite. The location was ideal for staying in Portree, so close to the town centre. Off-street parking was great.

items.name: Ron
items.text: Enjoyable and comfortable stay. Excellent price too. Very friendly establishment, comfortable and clean, with very good facilities. Nice short walk into town centre. Off-road parking too.
